computed_from: the four V1 exports (v1_rr_t4_a/b, v1_li_t4_a/b): frames/s = total_frames / total_span_s (working/scripts/p0_analyse_video.py v1 recomputes it)
threshold: gap - max(0.82%, spread rr_t4, spread li_t4) >= 10 percentage points
consequence_preregistered: a 168-video confirmation: rr_t4 and li_t4 once each, same session, interleaved
why_not_run: about 5 hours of box time (roughly 2.5 h RocketRide + 2 h LlamaIndex + start-up). Queued behind V2 (a pre-registered smoke experiment, ~2.7 h) and the fired H6 full bake-off (~0.75 h), it would end near 23:30Z, the estimated end of the SSO session (approved 07:57Z; the last session lasted ~15.5 h). The box can only be stopped from the laptop (our role cannot read the instance's shutdown behaviour, so an OS-initiated shutdown could TERMINATE it), and a confirmation that outlives the credentials would leave the box running with no way to stop it. V2 and H6 full carry more information: V2 decomposes the gap this run confirms in-session on both pairs.
what_it_would_need: a fresh SSO approval at its start and ~5 h of box time in the same box session as the V1 smoke (the gate fired in boot a58bf81c)
